decisions.reason: The accelerator program is still cheap to run, but it sits outside the core machinery business and nothing new shows that its partnership value is being realized, so it is kept for now with roughly even odds of being cut.
The infectious waste plant is a flagship co-developed with ERMAFA close to the core offer, and its market prospects are still resolving at low holding cost, so the option stays open.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the decentralized recycling strategy and existing manufacturing know-how, so it is cheap to maintain and still promising.
